name: Dreamscape Story Window
description: A calm story-world vignette seen through one quiet window of light, with a small readable title and a single gentle focal subject.
composition_guidance: Build one original, low-arousal story setting with a window, doorway, or frame of warm light. Keep one gentle character or small task visible and leave calm negative space for a short title.
required_elements: one quiet setting seen through a window, doorway, or frame
one gentle character or calming task
one short readable episode title in a safe text area
avoid_elements: violence, peril, urgency, cliffhangers, or alarming faces
dense collage, competing focal subjects, or high-contrast spectacle
logos, watermarks, copied compositions, or illegible text
headline_guidance: Render the exact concise episode title in calm, readable title case without adding a tease or command.
visual_style_guidance: Original soft watercolor storybook composition with a warm window glow, moonlit blues, paper texture, gentle shapes, and enough visual rest for a listener who is winding down.
